summary: Frontend-only verification of three new features: (1) public landing retirement-calculator teaser, (2) public legal pages (privacy, PIPEDA, terms) with plain-language badge/effective/disclaimer and EN/FR, (3) advisor digest preview modals on /tasks. All three features PASS end-to-end. Advisor logged in via API (login+MFA verify) and token stored in localStorage.compass_token to drive /tasks.
action_items: (Minor/optional) Escape key does not close the digest-preview modal; only the Close button and backdrop click close it. Consider wiring Escape for accessibility parity.

(Minor/optional) One background 401 console error was observed after mounting /tasks (unrelated to digest preview flow). Likely a stale/other endpoint call; worth a quick look at network tab to identify.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing teaser: res.p50 can show $0 at default inputs (success ~6%). This is mathematically correct for the Monte-Carlo decumulation (median path depletes before age 95) but visually it's a bit startling next to a $1M 'projected savings'. Consider labelling it 'Median balance at age 95' (already done) plus a small tooltip explaining that $0 means the median path depletes. Not a bug.
test_credentials: advisor@compass.ca / Compass2026! + TOTP(JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP). API-login then set localStorage.compass_token to bypass UI MFA step.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To drive advisor-authenticated UI tests, prefer API-login flow: POST /api/auth/login then /api/auth/mfa/verify with pyotp.TOTP('JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP').now(); then page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('compass_token', '<token>'); localStorage.setItem('compass_tier','advisor');") before navigating to /tasks (or any protected route). Driving the login form UI with the TOTP input selector proved brittle. For the landing calculator sliders, standard dispatchEvent won't trigger React updates — use Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set to set range input values, then dispatch input+change events.
